method: Extracted and compiled all three Python fences from the lesson; executed the threshold, recall-gate, and trace examples; checked exact TTL boundaries, failure behavior, output goldens, privacy fields, and historical evidence caveats. No provider calls were made.

observations.trace: The fixed-clock fixture independently rejects two disallowed sources and one expired user-stated memory; trace records injected/blocked IDs and request IDs without raw query text.

limitations: Historical A/B/C model requests, responses, route/version and scorer are unavailable; the 2026-10-08 output comparison was not reproduced and cannot establish causality or frequency.
The threshold fixture uses constructed scores only; it does not test embeddings, BM25, retrieval quality, or production task outcomes.
The source allowlist is one conservative teaching policy, not a universal trust policy.
Local tests do not verify production clocks, memory ownership, authorization, logging retention, or data quality.
